short.title: RENTAL AGREEMENT — SHORT STAY
short.intro:
Rental granted for a temporary stay, which does not constitute the
tenant's main residence.
long.title: RESIDENTIAL LEASE AGREEMENT
long.lawFr:
Drawn up in accordance with French law no. 89-462 of 6 July 1989, as amended,
and law no. 2014-366 of 24 March 2014 (ALUR law).
long.lawOther:
Drawn up in accordance with the legislation applicable in the country
where the rented property is located.
art1.title: ARTICLE 1 — THE PARTIES
field.name: Name: {value}
art2.title: ARTICLE 2 — DESCRIPTION OF THE PROPERTY
art2.intro: This agreement concerns the accommodation located at the following address:
art3.shortEnd:
The stay ends automatically on the stated date, without any need
to give notice. Any extension requires a new written agreement
between the parties.
art3.title: ARTICLE 3 — TERM OF THE LEASE
art3.fixed: This lease is entered into for a fixed term.
art3.open: This lease is entered into for an indefinite term.
art4.title: ARTICLE 4 — FINANCIAL TERMS
art4.stayPay: Payable in a single instalment, no later than the arrival date.
art4.stayDeposit:
Deposit: {amount}, returned at the end of the stay,
less any justified deductions.
art4.payDay: Rent is payable on day {day} of each month.
art4.depositFr:
The security deposit will be returned within a maximum of 2 months after
the keys are handed back, less any justified deductions.
art4.depositOther:
The security deposit will be returned after the keys are handed back, less
any justified deductions, within the time limits set by law.
art5.title: ARTICLE 5 — LANDLORD'S OBLIGATIONS
art5.decent: • Provide decent accommodation in a good state of use and repair.
art5.peace: • Ensure the tenant's peaceful enjoyment of the accommodation.
art5.maintain: • Maintain the premises in a condition fit for their intended use.
art5.repairs: • Carry out all repairs other than those incumbent on the tenant.
art6.title: ARTICLE 6 — TENANT'S OBLIGATIONS
art6.payStay: • Pay the amount of the stay on the agreed terms.
art6.payRent: • Pay the rent and charges on the agreed dates.
art6.use: • Use the rented premises peacefully, in accordance with their intended purpose.
art6.damage: • Be liable for damage and losses occurring during the term of the agreement.
art6.returnStay: • Return the accommodation on the end date of the stay.
art6.upkeep: • Bear the routine upkeep of the accommodation and tenant repairs.
art6.insurance: • Take out insurance against tenant risks.
art6.noChange: • Not alter the premises or equipment without the landlord's written consent.
revision.title: RENT REVIEW
revision.fr:
The rent may be reviewed annually on the anniversary date of the lease,
according to the change in the Rent Reference Index (IRL) published
by INSEE, in accordance with article 17-1 of the law of 6 July 1989.
revision.other:
The rent may be reviewed on the anniversary date of the lease, within the
limits set by the applicable legislation. Any review is recorded
in an amendment signed by the parties.
termination.title: TERMINATION
termination.tenant.one:
The tenant may terminate the lease at any time, subject to giving
{count} month of written notice to the landlord.
termination.tenant.other:
The tenant may terminate the lease at any time, subject to giving
{count} months of written notice to the landlord.
termination.ownerFr:
The landlord may give notice for the end of the lease term, with
{months} months' notice and on one of the grounds provided by law.
termination.ownerOther:
The landlord may give notice under the conditions and time limits set
by the applicable legislation.
